Here they stand in their abode, seated cross-legged with bodies unmoved,
they are seen simultaneously in all <s>kṣetras</s>, having gone everywhere. (43)
Here, abiding, these bulls among beings drink from the ocean of <s>Dharma</s> of the <s>Sugatas</s> (Well-Gone Ones),
having descended into the ocean of <s>jñāna</s> (wisdom), having attained the perfection of inexhaustible virtues. (44)

children.text: iha sarvakṣetrasaṃkhyāṃ kalpānāṃ caiva dharmasaṃkhyāṃ ca /
children.translated_text: Here, the number of all <s>kṣetras</s>, and the number of <s>kalpas</s> and of <s>Dharma</s> teachings,
and the number of all <s>Jinas</s> — they contemplate with unobstructed thought. (45)

children.text: iha te sthitā jinasutā yāvat kṣetrāstriyadhvasaṃkhyātāḥ /
children.translated_text: Here these sons of the <s>Jina</s> stand; as many <s>kṣetras</s> as are numbered through the three times,
in a single moment they investigate the arising and passing away of all those. (46)

children.text: iha te sthitā jinānāṃ caryāṃ praṇidhiṃ ca indriyaṃ jagatām /
children.translated_text: Here they stand, and the conduct of the <s>Jinas</s>, their vows, and the faculties of beings,
they see as equal, wandering in the mansion of the sons of the <s>Jina</s>. (47)
Those who have gone to the tip of a single atom — in this, with obstructions equal to all atoms,
they see oceans of assemblies, <s>kṣetras</s>, beings, and <s>kalpas</s>. (48)
Thus in all atom-tips, assemblies, <s>kṣetras</s>, beings, and <s>kalpas</s>,
all appearing as reflections, well-distinguished — they clearly perceive. (49)
Here they investigate the intrinsic nature of <s>Dharma</s>, all <s>kṣetras</s>, times, <s>kalpas</s>, and <s>Buddhas</s>,
free from the intrinsic nature of conditioned existence, through methods of non-arising. (50)

children.text: sthitveha sattvasamatāṃ dharmeṣu buddhasamatāṃ ca prekṣya /
children.translated_text: Standing here, perceiving the equality of beings and the equality of <s>Buddhas</s> among <s>dharmas</s>,
they enter into the equality of <s>kṣetras</s> across the three times and the equality of <s>praṇidhānas</s> (vows). (51)
Some discipline myriads of beings, others magnify myriads of <s>Buddhas</s>,

children.text: vimṛṣantyapare dharmāniha te bhavanavare sthitā dhīrāḥ // 52 //
children.translated_text: yet others investigate the <s>dharmas</s> — here they, the steadfast ones, stand in the excellent mansion. (52)
Even in myriads of <s>kalpas</s>, the domain of their <s>praṇidhāna</s>-wisdom, surpassing all conceptual elaboration,

children.text: śakyā mayā hi vaktuṃ vistīrṇo 'nantu buddhīnām // 53 //
children.translated_text: cannot be expressed by me — so vast and boundless is the scope of their wisdom. (53)
Of those blameless ones, devoted to the unobstructed domain,
I venerate their dwelling, with hands joined in a cup, body bowed in reverence. (54)
And that foremost son of the <s>Jina</s>, the noble <s>Maitreya</s>, whose conduct is unobstructed,
of incomparable, pure wisdom — to him next I, mindful, bow down in reverence. (55)

body.text: iti hi sudhanaḥ śreṣṭhidārako vairocanavyūhālaṃkāragarbhamahākūṭāgāranivāsino bodhisattvānevaṃ ca apramāṇairbodhisattvastavairabhiṣṭutya vanditvā namaskṛtya praṇipatya udvīkṣa citrīkṛtya āmukhībhūya abhisaṃpūjya vairocanavyūhālaṃkāragarbhasya mahākūṭāgārasya mūle 'tiṣṭhanmaitreyasya bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya darśanamabhilaṣamāṇo maitreyasya bodhisattvasya samavadhānamākāṅkṣamāṇaḥ / so 'drākṣīnmaitreyaṃ bodhisattvaṃ bahirdhā kūṭāgārasya anyatamasmātpradeśādāgacchantamanekaprāṇiśatasahasraparivāramanekadevanāgayakṣagandharvāsuragaruḍakinnaramahoragendrapuraskṛtaṃ vāmadakṣiṇābhyāṃ śakrabrahmalokapālairnamasyamānaṃ janmabhūmikaiśca bahubhirjñātisaṃbandhibhirbrāhmaṇaśatasahasraiḥ parivṛtaṃ puraskṛtaṃ vairocanavyūhālaṃkāragarbhakūṭāgārābhimukhamāgacchantam / dṛṣṭvā ca tuṣṭa udagra āttamanāḥ pramuditaḥ prītisaumanasyajāto yena maitreyo bodhisattvastenābhimukho bhūtvā dūrata eva maitreyasya bodhisattvasya sarvaśarīreṇa praṇipatitaḥ //
body.translated_text: [Thus <s>Sudhana</s>, the merchant's son, addressed the <s>bodhisattvas</s> dwelling in the <s>Vairocanavyūhālaṃkāragarbha</s> great pavilion in this manner, and...] [TEXT TRUNCATED]

body.text: atha khalu maitreyo bodhisattvaḥ sudhanaṃ śreṣṭhidārakaṃ vyavalokya sarvaparṣado dakṣiṇena hastenopadarśya bhūtairguṇaiḥ saṃvarṇayan gāthābhiradhyabhāṣata -
body.translated_text: [Then the <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>Maitreya</s>, beholding <s>Sudhana</s> the merchant's son, pointed him out to the entire assembly with his right hand...] [TEXT TRUNCATED]

children.translated_text: Behold this <s>Sudhana</s>, of thoroughly pure intention, son of <s>Dṛḍhadhana</s>,
seeking the excellent <s>bodhisattva</s> conduct, this wise one has come into my presence. (56)
Welcome, O one born of compassion and loving-kindness! Welcome, O one of the vast sphere of <s>maitrī</s> (loving-kindness)!

children.text: svāgataṃ praśamaśāntilocana mā kilāmyasi carantu cārikām // 57 //
children.translated_text: Welcome, O one whose eyes are tranquil and serene! Do not grow weary as you walk the path! (57)
Come, welcome, O one of pure intention! Come, welcome, O one of unwearied mind!

children.text: ehi svāgatamalīnaindriyā mā kilāmyāsi carantu sūrata // 58 //
children.translated_text: Come, welcome, O one of untarnished faculties! Do not grow weary as you practice, O virtuous one! (58)
Arisen for the investigation of all <s>dharmas</s>, eager for the discipline of all beings,

children.text: sarvamitrabhajanāya prasthitā svāgataṃ ti acalā dṛḍhavratā // 59 //
children.translated_text: set forth for the devotion to all spiritual friends — welcome, O unwavering one of firm vows! (59)

children.text: svāgataṃ śubhapathena āgatā svāgataṃ guṇapathe pratiṣṭhitā /
children.translated_text: Welcome, you who have come by the auspicious path! Welcome, you who are established on the path of virtue!

children.text: svāgataṃ jinapathena prasthitā mā śramaṃ kila samarthasva kvacit // 60 //
children.translated_text: Welcome, you who have set forth on the path of the <s>Jinas</s>! Do not yield to weariness anywhere! (60)

children.text: ehi svāgatu guṇeṣu tanmayā svāgataṃ ti kuśalāni(bhi)syandita(?) /
children.translated_text: Come, welcome, O one absorbed in virtues! Welcome, O one overflowing with wholesome merit!

children.text: sādhu svāgatamanantagocarā darśanaṃ tava sudurlabhaṃ jage // 61 //
children.translated_text: Well done, welcome, O one of boundless scope! Your sight is exceedingly rare in the world. (61)
O one whose mind is equal toward gain and loss, free from blame, suffering, and ill-repute,
like a lotus amid worldly conditions — well done, welcome, O one of unconfused mind! (62)
Free from deceit and fraud, of auspicious intention; free from pride and arrogance, a worthy vessel;

children.text: krodharoṣavigatā anunnata sādhu te darśanaṃ sudarśanam // 63 //
children.translated_text: free from anger and wrath, never puffed up — excellent indeed is the sight of you, O beautiful one! (63)
Come, O one facing the domain of all directions! Come, O one born from the treasury of all directions!
Come, O one who increases the treasury of all <s>Jinas</s>! Welcome, O one of unwearied mind! (64)
Come, welcome, O one whose domain spans the three times! O one whose sphere is devotion to the <s>dharmadhātu</s> (realm of reality)!
O one born from the womb of the virtues of all <s>Buddhas</s> — welcome, O unwearied, virtuous one! (65)
Come, O lotus of the wisdom of <s>Mañjuśrī</s>! Come, O one nourished by the waters of <s>Meghaśrī</s>!

children.text: ehi sarvajinaputrapreṣita darśayāmi ti anāvṛtāṃ diśam // 66 //
children.translated_text: Come, O one sent by all the sons of the <s>Jinas</s>! I shall show you the unobstructed direction. (66)
Behold what manner of net of <s>praṇidhānas</s> (vows) this is — the inconceivable pervading of the <s>dharmadhātu</s>,
the drawing forth on the path of <s>bodhisattva</s> conduct — let <s>Sudhana</s> be welcome, who has come here! (67)

children.text: eṣamāṇu sugatāna gocaraṃ mārgamāṇu virajāna cārikām /
children.translated_text: Seeking the domain of the <s>Sugatas</s>, searching for the conduct of the stainless ones,
inquiring about the ocean of <s>praṇidhānas</s> — he has come, this one of unwearied mind. (68)

children.text: yatra śikṣita atīta nāyakāḥ śikṣiṣenti tatha ye anāgatāḥ /
children.translated_text: Where the past leaders trained, and where those of the future shall train,

children.text: tiṣṭhatāṃ ca sugatāna yā carī pṛcchamāṇu ayu tāmihāgataḥ // 69 //
children.translated_text: and the conduct of the <s>Sugatas</s> who now abide — inquiring about that, this one has come here. (69)
These are my friends, the proclaimers of <s>Dharma</s>, the teachers of the practice of all <s>dharmas</s>,
the guides on the path of <s>bodhisattva</s> conduct — with precisely this thought, he has come here. (70)

children.text: bodhisattva mama buddhivardhikā buddhaputra mama bodhidāyakāḥ /
children.translated_text: These <s>bodhisattvas</s> increase my wisdom, these sons of the <s>Buddha</s> are givers of my <s>bodhi</s> (awakening),

children.text: eti mitra mama buddhavarṇitā evacittakuśalo ihāgataḥ // 71 //
children.translated_text: these are my friends praised by the <s>Buddhas</s> — with precisely this wholesome thought, he has come here. (71)
These are like mothers and fathers to me, like nurses who give the milk of virtues,
protectors of the limbs of <s>bodhi</s> always, such friends who ward off what is harmful. (72)
Like physicians who liberate from old age and death, like <s>Śakra</s> (Indra) who rains down the nectar of immortality,
like the moon with its beautiful full orb, like the sun showing the auspicious path. (73)
Like <s>Meru</s>, equal toward friends and foes; like the ocean, with unshakeable minds;
like a helmsman and guardian — with precisely this thought, <s>Sudhana</s> has come here. (74)
Like heroes, givers of fearlessness; like caravan leaders, a refuge and final resort;

children.text: nāyakā mama sukhaṃdadā ime evacitta ayu mitra sevate // 75 //
children.translated_text: these are my guides who bestow happiness — with precisely this thought, he serves these friends. (75)
Always showing the way of all <s>dharmas</s>, always revealing the wisdom and virtues of all <s>Buddhas</s>,

children.text: sarvadurgatiapāyaśodhakā eti mitra mama sādhu darśakāḥ // 76 //
children.translated_text: purifiers of all evil destinies and lower realms — such are my friends, excellent guides. (76)
These are givers of the treasury of all <s>Jinas</s>, these are guardians of the storehouse of all <s>Jinas</s>,

children.text: eti sarvajinaguhyadhārakā eva mitra bhajateṣa paṇḍitaḥ // 77 //
children.translated_text: these are bearers of the secrets of all <s>Jinas</s> — it is precisely such friends that this wise one serves. (77)
From these, the wealth of <s>jñāna</s> (wisdom) is purified; the splendors of form, enjoyment, family, and birth —
[...] from these are not difficult to obtain — with precisely this intention, he has come here. (78)

children.text: paśyathā ayamudāraāśayaḥ sevamāna ima mitra paṇḍitaḥ /
children.translated_text: Behold this one of noble intention, this wise one who serves these friends!

children.text: yādṛśīṃ pratijaneti sūrata eva yūyamanuśikṣatho sadā // 79 //
children.translated_text: Whatever kind of practice he undertakes, O virtuous ones — may you always train likewise! (79)
This one, through the cause of previous auspicious merit, having seen <s>Mañjuśrī</s>, set forth toward <s>bodhi</s>,

children.text: anuśāsti ayu tasya kurvato paśyathā kathamaṭatyakhedavān // 80 //
children.translated_text: and following his instructions, acting upon them — behold how he wanders without weariness! (80)

children.text: eṣa sarvasukhasaukhya ujjhiya utsṛjitva amaropamaṃ gṛham /
children.translated_text: This one, having abandoned all pleasures and comforts, having cast off his home like a celestial palace,
the expansive enjoyments of nurse, mother, and father — he serves these friends as a servant. (81)

children.text: eṣa āśaya viśodhya paṇḍitaḥ svāśrayaṃ jahiya mānuṣaṃ imam /
children.translated_text: This wise one, having purified his intention, having left behind this human condition,
will enter the mansion of all <s>Buddhas</s> — such will be the fruit of this. (82)
This one, having seen people afflicted by disease, living beings assailed by hundreds of sufferings,
tormented by the sorrows and fears of birth and death — for their sake he walks the path with a mind of compassion. (83)
Having seen the world crushed by the machine of suffering in the wheel of the five destinies,
he seeks the adamantine <s>vajra</s> of <s>jñāna</s>, firm and strong, to shatter the wheel of the machine of suffering. (84)
The thorns and stumps and brambles of passion and hatred, the thick tangle of the thicket of wrong views,
desiring to purify the field of beings — he firmly seeks the plough of <s>prajñā</s> (wisdom). (85)
The world, its disposition a dense thicket of delusion and ignorance, its eye of wisdom destroyed, bereft of a guide,
he, capable of showing the direction of peace — will become the caravan leader of the world. (86)
With <s>kṣānti</s> (patience), <s>Dharma</s>, and the three <s>vimokṣas</s> (liberations) as his vehicle, with the sword of <s>jñāna</s> as vanquisher of the enemy <s>kleśas</s> (afflictions),

children.text: śūrabhūta abhayasya dāyako deśiko hi jagatāṃ bhaviṣyati // 87 //
children.translated_text: like a hero, a giver of fearlessness — he will become a guide for all beings. (87)
He brings forth the ship of <s>Dharma</s>, well-trained on the path of the ocean of <s>jñāna</s>,
a guide to the excellent island of the jewel of peace — he is the helmsman on the ocean of the three realms of existence. (88)

body.text: jñānaraśmipraṇidhānamaṇḍalaḥ sarvasattvabhuvanāvabhāsanaḥ /
body.translated_text: With a sphere of rays of <s>jñāna</s> and <s>praṇidhānas</s>, illuminating the abodes of all beings,

body.text: dharmadhātugagane mahāprabho buddhasūrya samudeṣyate ayam // 89 //
body.translated_text: a great luminary in the sky of the <s>dharmadhātu</s> — this one will arise as the <s>Buddha</s>-sun. (89)

children.translated_text: Cool as <s>maitri</s>-sandalwood, with a mind equal toward all beings, radiant,
with a full orb of pure white <s>dharmas</s> — this one will arise as the <s>Buddha</s>-moon. (90)
Firmly established on the solid ground of intention, having gradually risen through <s>bodhisattva</s> conduct,
this one, a mine of the jewels of all <s>dharmas</s>, will become the supreme ocean of <s>jñāna</s>. (91)
Born from the serpent-king of <s>bodhicitta</s> (the mind of awakening), risen into the sky of the <s>dharmadhātu</s>,
simultaneously raining forth <s>Dharma</s>-clouds — causing the growth of the crops and fruits of all that is wholesome. (92)
Of pure conduct, dispelling the darkness of the three defilements, a firm vessel of <s>maitrī</s>-love, mindfulness,
brilliant with the stainless fire of <s>bodhicitta</s> — this one will kindle the lamp of <s>Dharma</s>. (93)
The embryo of <s>bodhicitta</s>, the moist lump of compassion, the flesh-mass of <s>maitrī</s>, the solid lump of joyous intention,
This <s>buddhagarbha</s> (buddha-womb) grows, born from the gradual arising of the <s>bodhyaṅga</s>s (limbs of awakening). // 94 //

body.text: pūnyagarbhamabhivardhayiṣyati jñānagarbhamapi śodhayiṣyati

children.translated_text: this one is designated as the womb of knowledge — such is his birth from the womb of vows. // 95 //

body.translated_text: He will increase the womb of merit and will purify the womb of knowledge;

children.translated_text: Such is he, armored with compassion and loving-kindness, intent on liberating beings, of benevolent disposition;

children.text: durlabho jagi sadevamānuṣe yādṛśo ayu viśuddhamānasaḥ // 96 //
children.translated_text: rare in the world of <s>Deva</s>s and humans is one like this, of purified mind. // 96 //
One established in such excellent roots of aspiration, one grown through such firm application,
such a radiance covering the three existences — a knowledge-tree bearing fruit is exceedingly rare. // 96 //
This one seeks the arising of qualities, seeks the investigation of all <s>dharma</s>s,
seeks the dispelling of all doubts — he serves all spiritual friends, unwearied. // 97 //
This one destroys the stains of <s>Māra</s> and the <s>kleśa</s>s (afflictions); this one purifies the defilements of wrong views and craving;
this one strives for the liberation of all the world — this is your ever-distinguished sage. // 98 //
This one will purify the lower realms; this one will reveal heaven;
he will lead the world to the path of liberation — such is he, established on the path of qualities. // 99 //
This one liberates from the suffering of all destinies; this one bestows happiness in all destinies;
this one cuts the bonds of all existences — he will become the destroyer of the courses of existence. // 100 //
He will liberate from the straits of wrong views; he will cut the creeping net of craving;
he will purify the delight and attachment — he will become the guide of the path through the three existences. // 101 //

children.text: eṣa lokaśaraṇaṃ parāyaṇaṃ eṣa sarvajagati prabhākaraḥ /
children.translated_text: This one is the refuge of the world, the supreme goal; this one is the light-maker in all the world;
he will become the leader in the three worlds, skilled in discerning existence everywhere. // 102 //
The wise one who purifies beings asleep in <s>kleśa</s>s, who carries across the tree-mire of desire,
this one who liberates those attached to perceptions — he will become the maker of release from bondage. // 103 //
Illuminating the differentiation of the expanse of the <s>dharmadhātu</s>, purifying the differentiation of the expanse of world-realms,
having gone beyond the differentiation of the expanse of all <s>dharma</s>s — you will become so, O <s>Sudhana</s>, be joyful! // 104 //

children.text: yādṛśaṃ tava prayoga sūrataḥ śraddha yādṛśa tavā aninditaḥ /
children.translated_text: Such is your heroic application, such is your blameless faith;
such is the quality of your virtuous aspiration — it will fulfill everything. // 105 //

children.text: sarvabuddha nacireṇa drakṣyasi sarvakṣetra nacireṇa yāsyasi /
children.translated_text: You will see all <s>Buddha</s>s before long; you will go to all fields before long;

children.text: sarvadharma nacireṇa jñāsyasi tādṛśaṃ ti śubhamātmanā kṛtam // 106 //
children.translated_text: you will know all <s>dharma</s>s before long — such is the merit you have created by yourself. // 106 //
You will purify oceans of fields; you will liberate oceans of beings;
you will fill oceans of conduct — such is your ocean of practice. // 107 //

children.text: tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi guṇān bhājanaṃ tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi śubhāna saṃbhavaḥ /
children.translated_text: You will become a vessel of qualities; you will become the source of merit;

children.text: tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi jinaurasaiḥ samo yādṛśaṃ ti adhimuktimaṇḍalam // 108 //
children.translated_text: you will become equal to the true sons of the <s>Jina</s>s — such is your circle of <s>adhimukti</s> (resolute faith). // 108 //

children.text: māramaṇḍala parājitaṃ tvayā karmamaṇḍala viśodhitaṃ ca te /
children.translated_text: The circle of <s>Māra</s> has been defeated by you; the circle of <s>karma</s> has been purified by you;

children.text: kleśamaṇḍala viśodhitaṃ tvayā yādṛśaṃ ti praṇidhānamaṇḍalam // 109 //
children.translated_text: the circle of <s>kleśa</s>s has been purified by you — such is your circle of vows. // 109 //
You will purify the path of knowledge; you will glorify the path of <s>Dharma</s>;
before long you will turn back the path of the mechanism of <s>karma</s>, <s>kleśa</s>s, and suffering. // 110 //

body.text: lokacakrabhavacakramāśritaṃ pañcagaṇḍagaticakramohitam /
body.translated_text: The wheel of the world, clinging to the wheel of existence, deluded by the wheel of the five destinies,

body.text: sarvasattvadukhacakracchedanaṃ dharmacakrataru vartayiṣyasi // 111 //
body.translated_text: cutting the wheel of suffering of all beings — you will turn the great tree of the <s>Dharmacakra</s> (Wheel of the Dharma). // 111 //

children.translated_text: You will uphold the lineage of <s>Buddha</s>s; you will purify the lineage of <s>Dharma</s>;
you will extend the lineage of <s>Saṅgha</s> — you will become the producer of the jewel-arising. // 112 //
You will turn back the net of craving; likewise the dense thicket of views;

children.text: duḥkhajāla jagu mocayiṣyase tādṛśaḥ praṇidhijālu śodhitaḥ // 113 //
children.translated_text: you will liberate the world from the net of suffering — such is one whose net of vows is purified. // 113 //
You will ripen the realm of beings; you will purify the realm of worlds;
you will raise up the realm of knowledge — such is the realm of your aspiration. // 114 //
Delighting in the welfare and joy of all beings, a joy of the family-lineage of <s>Bodhisattva</s>s,
a joy of the vows of all <s>Buddha</s>s — you will become, O <s>Sudhana</s>, an increaser of joy. // 115 //
Seeing the abodes of all beings in all destinies, seeing the reflected images of all fields,
seeing the illumination of all <s>dharma</s>s — you will become a <s>Jina</s>, beautiful to behold. // 116 //
A radiance illuminating the expanse of the <s>dharmadhātu</s>, a radiance pacifying all lower destinies,
you will become the pacifier of the suffering of the three existences. // 117 //
You will reveal the gate of heaven; you will open the gate of <s>Buddha</s>hood for the world;

children.text: mokṣadvāramupaneṣyase jagat dvāru tādṛśu viśodhitaṃ tvayā // 118 //
children.translated_text: you will lead the world to the gate of liberation — such a gate has been purified by you. // 118 //

body.text: mithyamārga vinivartayiṣyase āryamārga janatāṃ vineṣyasi /
body.translated_text: You will turn back from the wrong path; you will lead beings to the noble path;

body.text: bodhimārga tatha tvaṃ anuddhato mārgase dṛḍhamate atandritaḥ // 119 //
body.translated_text: and likewise on the path of <s>Bodhi</s>, you, unagitated, of firm mind, untiring, will seek the path. // 119 //

children.translated_text: You, eager for embodied beings gone into the ocean of existence to cross over the suffering,
will carry the world across the ocean of existence — become such a great ocean of qualities! // 120 //
Drying up the ocean of <s>kleśa</s>s of embodied beings with oceans of excellent rays of the sun of knowledge,
establishing them in the ocean of practice, you will ground them in the ocean of knowledge. // 121 //
You will increase the ocean of wisdom; you will purify the ocean of conduct;
before long you will plunge into the ocean of all <s>Buddha</s>-vows. // 122 //

children.text: kṣetrasāgara bahu pravekṣyasi drakṣyase pariṣasāgarān bahūn /
children.translated_text: You will enter many oceans of fields; you will see many oceans of assemblies;
the wise one, by the power of the ocean of wisdom... // 123 //
You will see ten-thousands of <s>Buddha</s>-clouds; you will make vast clouds of offerings;
you will hear ten-thousands of <s>Dharma</s>-clouds — such are the clouds of vows you create. // 124 //
You will pervade the dwellings of all beings; you will go to the dwellings of all fields;
you will enter the dwelling of all <s>Buddha</s>s — set forth toward such a direction! // 125 //

children.text: tvaṃ samādhibhavanaṃ pravekṣyase tvaṃ vimokṣabhavanāni lapsyase /
children.translated_text: You will enter the dwelling of <s>samādhi</s>; you will attain the dwellings of liberation;
...established in the dwelling of the <s>dharmadhātu</s>. // 126 //

body.text: sarvasattvabhavane udeṣyase candrasūryapratibhāsasādṛśaḥ /
body.translated_text: You will rise in the dwelling of all beings, like the reflected images of the moon and sun;

body.text: udgamiṣyasi jināna saṃmukhaṃ tādṛśastava mahāpathodgamaḥ // 127 //
body.translated_text: you will arise before the <s>Jina</s>s — such is your great setting forth on the path. // 127 //

children.translated_text: You will course in the domain of the virtuous, in the domain of all worlds without abode,
you will be one of tranquil domain — such is your domain of <s>abhijñā</s> (superknowledge). // 128 //
The wise one who penetrates the differentiation of the expanse of <s>Indra</s>'s net, however many differentiations of field-nets there are,

children.text: nocireṇa spharamāṇu paśyase māruto va gagane asaṅgavān // 129 //
children.translated_text: before long you will see them pervading as atoms — like the wind in the sky, unattached. // 129 //
You will enter the extent of the <s>dharmadhātu</s>; you will go to the extents of world-realms;
you will see the extents of all <s>Buddha</s>s in the three times — O <s>Sudhana</s>, find joy! // 130 //

children.text: maiva kheda janayāhi sūratā tuṣṭi vindi vipulāṃ nirāmiṣam /
children.translated_text: Do not generate weariness, O hero! Find vast, immaterial satisfaction;

children.text: yena te imu vimokṣu īdṛśo dṛṣṭu paśyasi ca bhūyu drakṣyase // 131 //
children.translated_text: by which you see this very liberation of such a kind — and you will see yet more. // 131 //
You are a worthy vessel of qualities, O <s>Sudhana</s>, ... in the instructions of the <s>Jina</s>s;

children.text: tvaṃ samartha imu dhārituṃ nayaṃ tena paśyasi idaṃ vikurvitam // 132 //
children.translated_text: you are able to uphold this method — therefore you see this miraculous display. // 132 //

children.text: yeṣa kalpanayutaiḥ sudurlabhaṃ darśanaṃ kutu guṇaprabhāvana /
children.translated_text: The sight of those for whom even ten-thousands of <s>kalpa</s>s are insufficient — how much less the manifestation of qualities!

children.text: tehi dṛṣṭa carato sucārikāṃ buddhaputra aniketagocarāḥ // 133 //
children.translated_text: Those sons of the <s>Buddha</s> have been seen practicing the excellent conduct, coursing in the domain without abode. // 133 //

children.text: lābha bhūya vipulā acintiyā svāgataṃ ca tava mānuṣo bhava /
children.translated_text: Your gain is vast, inconceivable! Welcome to your human existence!

children.text: yena mañjuśiri dṛṣṭa saṃmukhamīdṛśaṃ kṛtu guṇān bhājanam // 134 //
children.translated_text: For you have seen <s>Mañjuśrī</s> face to face — such has been made a vessel of qualities. // 134 //

body.text: sarvadurgatipathā vivardhitāḥ sarvaakṣaṇaapāyaśodhakāḥ /
body.translated_text: All paths of lower destinies have been overcome; all untimely births and bad destinies are purified;

body.text: duḥkhadharma tvayi sarva ujjhitāḥ sarvakheda ca vivarjitā bhava // 135 //
body.translated_text: all <s>dharma</s>s of suffering in you have been abandoned — may all weariness be cast away! // 135 //

children.translated_text: The stage of the foolish has been turned back by you; you are well-established on the stage of <s>Bodhisattva</s> qualities;

children.text: jñānabhūmi paripūrya uttamā buddhabhūmi nacireṇa lapsyase // 136 //
children.translated_text: having fulfilled the supreme stage of knowledge, you will before long attain the <s>Buddha</s>-stage. // 136 //
<s>Bodhisattva</s>-conduct is like an ocean; the method of <s>Buddha</s>-knowledge is like space;
the oceans of vows are of that measure — be joyful regarding those! // 137 //
Those of such unwearied faculties, of such firm aspiration and determined application,

children.text: ye bhajanti ima mitra īdṛśāḥ te bhavanti nacireṇa nāyakāḥ // 138 //
children.translated_text: who serve spiritual friends of this kind — they will before long become leaders. // 138 //

children.text: dṛṣṭva sattva vinayaṃgatā bahu bodhisattvacari citra yāvat /
children.translated_text: Having seen many beings gone to discipline, and the marvelous <s>Bodhisattva</s>-conduct in all its variety,

children.text: mā tu jātu vimatiṃ kariṣyase sarvadharmamukha bodhicārikam // 139 //
children.translated_text: never shall you engender doubt — all <s>dharma</s>-gates are the conduct of <s>Bodhi</s>. // 139 //
Your perfection of merit is inconceivable, as are your perfections of meaning, <s>Dharma</s>, qualities, and faith;

children.text: yena saṃpada imā tvamīdṛśī buddhaputra iha adya paśyasi // 140 //
children.translated_text: by which perfections you, O son of the <s>Buddha</s>, see such things here today. // 140 //

children.text: paśya lābha tava kīdṛśo mahān paśyato jinasutā nirantaram /
children.translated_text: Behold how great your gain is! Seeing the sons of the <s>Jina</s> continuously,
they show their respective vows, and you follow them all completely. // 141 //
Rare even in hundreds of existences are such vessels of <s>Bodhisattva</s>-conduct;

children.text: tena co jinasutā nirantaraṃ te vimokṣanaya darśayanti mām // 142 //
children.translated_text: therefore the sons of the <s>Jina</s> continuously show me their methods of liberation. // 142 //

body.text: kalpakoṭinayutāni te janā saṃvasanti sugatātmajaiḥ saha /
body.translated_text: Those people dwell for ten-thousands of <s>koṭī</s>s of <s>kalpa</s>s with the sons of the <s>Sugata</s>,

body.text: te 'pi teṣu na vidanti gocaraṃ nātma tairhi guṇabhājanaṃ kṛtam // 143 //
body.translated_text: yet even they do not perceive their domain — for they have not made themselves vessels of qualities. // 143 //

children.text: tvaṃ śṛṇoṣi ima īdṛśaṃ nayaṃ paśyase ca sudurlabhaṃ jage /
children.translated_text: You hear this method of such a kind; and you see what is exceedingly rare in the world,
the miraculous display of the great <s>Bodhisattva</s>s — O <s>Sudhana</s>, be of supreme mind! // 144 //

children.text: sarvabuddha samanvāharanti te bodhisattva tava saṃgrahasthitāḥ /
children.translated_text: All <s>Buddha</s>s are mindful of you; <s>Bodhisattva</s>s are established in your gathering;

children.text: tvaṃ ca teṣa anuśāsanisthitaḥ sādhu sūdhana sujīvitaṃ tava // 145 //
children.translated_text: and you are established in their instruction — excellent, O <s>Sudhana</s>, well-lived is your life! // 145 //

children.text: bodhisattvakuladharmi vartase śikṣase jinasutāna tvaṃ guṇaiḥ /
children.translated_text: You conduct yourself in the <s>dharma</s> of the <s>Bodhisattva</s> family; you train in the qualities of the sons of the <s>Jina</s>;

children.text: bheṣyase sugatavaṃśavardhanaḥ prīti vindahi udāra sudhanā // 146 //
children.translated_text: you will become an increaser of the <s>Sugata</s>'s lineage — find joy, O noble <s>Sudhana</s>! // 146 //

children.text: sarvabuddha pitarastavāsamā bodhisattva tava sarvi bhrātaraḥ /
children.translated_text: All <s>Buddha</s>s are equal to your fathers; all <s>Bodhisattva</s>s are your brothers;

children.text: bodhiaṅga tava sarvi jñātayaḥ tvaṃ sujātu sugatāna orasaḥ // 147 //
children.translated_text: all <s>bodhyaṅga</s>s (limbs of awakening) are your kinsmen — you are well-born, a true son of the <s>Sugata</s>s. // 147 //
Bearer of the family-lineage of the <s>Dharma</s>-king, increaser of the family-lineage of <s>Bodhisattva</s>s,

children.text: dharmarājamacireṇa lapsyase sūdhanā tuṣṭa bhava prīṇitendriyaḥ // 148 //
children.translated_text: you will before long attain the <s>Dharma</s>-kingship — O <s>Sudhana</s>, be content, with faculties delighted! // 148 //
The supreme <s>abhiṣeka</s> (consecration) of all <s>Buddha</s>s, before long ... you will attain, wondrous!
You will become equal to the peerless true sons of the <s>Jina</s> — become such, become their companion! // 149 //

children.text: yādṛśaṃ vapati bīja yo naro tādṛśaṃ labhati tasya so phalam /
children.translated_text: Whatever seed a person sows, such is the fruit that one obtains;

children.text: prīti vinda vipulāmacintiyāṃ eṣa te 'dya samanvāsayāmyaham // 150 //
children.translated_text: find vast, inconceivable joy — today I grant you this attainment. // 150 //

children.text: cīrṇa kalpanayutāna ye carī bodhisattvanayutā acintiyā /
children.translated_text: Those who have practiced the conduct of inconceivable ten-thousands of <s>Bodhisattva</s>s through <s>kalpa</s> ten-thousands,

children.text: ta 'pi saṃpada labhanti nedṛśīmekajanmi pratilabdha yā tvayā // 151 //
children.translated_text: even they do not obtain such a perfection as has been attained by you in a single birth. // 151 //

children.text: sarvametadiha muktitaḥ phalaṃ āśayasya dṛḍhavīryatāya ca /
children.translated_text: All this here is the fruit of liberation, and of firm aspiration and vigor,

children.text: yasya cārika bhavediyaṃ priyā so dhareya sudhanasya yā carī // 152 //
children.translated_text: and of one to whom this conduct is dear — may such a one uphold the conduct of <s>Sudhana</s>! // 152 //
All conduct arises from vows; all <s>dharma</s>s arise from <s>adhimukti</s> (resolute faith);

children.text: sudhana eva samudānitāstvayā nityameṣa hi viśeṣacārikā // 153 //
children.translated_text: they have been brought together by <s>Sudhana</s> himself — for this is always a distinguished conduct. // 153 //
Just as the wind-born arises from serpent-consciousness, just as the water-born comes into being,
just as the domain of vow-knowledge arises from wind — so spreads the conduct of <s>Bodhi</s>. // 154 //

children.text: eṣa bhotu tava darśito tayā bhadranāmacariyāya sūdhana /
children.translated_text: Let this be shown to you by that one named <s>Bhadra</s> of excellent conduct, O <s>Sudhana</s>;

children.text: eta jñātva sa kadāci bheṣyate sevamāna iha mitra tanmayaḥ // 155 //
children.translated_text: knowing this, one will sometime become such, serving spiritual friends here, absorbed in them. // 155 //

children.text: kāyakoṭi smara pūrvikā tvayā kāmahetu kṣayitā nirarthakam /
children.translated_text: Remember the <s>koṭī</s>s of bodies in your past lives, wasted to no purpose for the sake of desire;

children.text: adya bodhiya mārgaṇo hyayaṃ kāya tarjatu vratena suvrataḥ // 156 //
children.translated_text: today this one seeks <s>Bodhi</s> — let the body be mortified by austerity, O one of excellent vows! // 156 //
You have passed through <s>koṭī</s>s of <s>kalpa</s>s, experiencing all suffering in the conditioned;

children.text: gaṅgavālikasamatā virāgitā buddha no ca śruta īdṛśo nayaḥ // 157 //
children.translated_text: Equal to the grains of sand of the <s>Gaṅgā</s> are those freed from passion -- such a method we have not heard from the <s>Buddhas</s>. // 157 //

children.text: so idāni kṣaṇa labdha mānuṣo buddhapādu imu mitru īdṛśāḥ /
children.translated_text: Now he has obtained this moment of human birth, such friends at the feet of the <s>Buddhas</s>,

children.text: śrūyate ca varabodhicārikā viśuddhi na bhaviṣyate katham // 158 //
children.translated_text: And the excellent <s>bodhisattva</s> career is being heard -- how could purification not come about? // 158 //

children.text: bhoti bhūya sugatāna saṃbhavo mitradharmaśravaṇaṃ ca śrūyate /
children.translated_text: May there be again the arising of <s>Sugatas</s>, and may the hearing of the friend's <s>Dharma</s> be heard,

children.text: no ca śrūyati ayaṃ punarnayo āśayo yadi na bhoti śodhitaḥ // 159 //
children.translated_text: But this method is not heard again if one's aspiration is not purified. // 159 //
Therefore, having generated faith, aspiration, and conviction, with supreme reverence for the teacher,
Free from doubt, wrong views, and weariness, hear again and again this such method! // 160 //

children.text: teṣa lābha paramā acintiyāsteṣa mānuṣabhavaḥ suāgataḥ /
children.translated_text: Supreme and inconceivable is the gain of those whose human existence has been well-attained,

children.text: yairiyaṃ cari praveśamīdṛśaṃ śrutva eva praṇidhī bhirnirhṛtā // 161 //
children.translated_text: Who, having heard of such an entry into this career, have brought forth their vows. // 161 //

children.text: tasya sarvi sugatā na durlabhā tasya sarvi jinaputra nārataḥ /
children.translated_text: For that one, all <s>Sugatas</s> are not difficult to attain; for that one, all sons of the <s>Jina</s> are never distant,

children.text: tasya bodhayi na bhūyu saṃśayo yena eva adhimukti śodhitā // 162 //
children.translated_text: For that one there is no further doubt about awakening -- the one whose aspiration has been purified. // 162 //

children.text: tena sarvi vinayā na varjitāḥ tena sarvadukhadharma ujjhitāḥ /
children.translated_text: By that one, all disciplines are not abandoned; by that one, all qualities of suffering are cast off,

children.text: tena sarvaguṇasaṃgrahaḥ kṛtaḥ yo imaṃ nayu praviṣṭa īdṛśam // 163 //
children.translated_text: By that one, the gathering of all virtues is accomplished -- the one who has entered such a method as this. // 163 //

children.text: nocireṇa imu kāyu ujjhiyā buddhakṣetra pariśuddha yāsyasi /
children.translated_text: Before long, having cast off this body, you will go to a purified buddha-field,
You will enter the abode of <s>bodhisattvas</s>, and you will behold the <s>Tathāgatas</s> in the ten directions. // 164 //

children.text: pūrvahetughana tubhya sūdhana pratyutpanna adhimukti niścitā /
children.translated_text: Dense are your previous causes, O <s>Sudhana</s>, and your present aspiration is firmly resolved,

children.text: mitra sevasi viśeṣaarthikaḥ tena vardhayi jale yathotpalam // 165 //
children.translated_text: You attend upon spiritual friends desiring special benefit -- therefore you flourish like a lotus in water. // 165 //
With aspirations to please all spiritual friends, with aspirations to worship all <s>Buddhas</s>,
With aspirations to inquire into all <s>dharmas</s> -- arise, O one of excellent vows, do not be weary! // 166 //
Arisen in the practice of all <s>dharmas</s>, well-established in following all paths and sub-paths,
Well-established in the vows of the sons of the <s>Buddhas</s>, arise, O vessel of all virtuous qualities! // 167 //

children.text: yādṛśāya adhimuktisaṃpadā vandanaṃ kṛtamidaṃ tvayā mama /
children.translated_text: With whatever excellence of aspiration you have made this salutation to me,
Before long you will rise up in the assemblies of all <s>Buddhas</s> face to face. // 168 //
Well done, O <s>Sudhana</s>, of unwearied mind, with the intention of the vows of all <s>Buddhas</s>,
You, of firm vows, will before long have gone to the farther shore of all <s>Buddha</s> qualities.

body.text: 169 // sattva mañjuśiri pṛccha sūdhana jñānagocaravimokṣapāragam /

children.text: bhadranāma vara carya uttamāṃ tanumantime praveśayiṣyati // 170 //
children.translated_text: And will cause him to enter the excellent and supreme career called <s>Bhadra</s> (the Auspicious) at the very end. // 170 //

body.translated_text: // 169 // The being <s>Mañjuśrī</s> shall ask <s>Sudhana</s>, who has reached the farther shore of the range of knowledge and liberation,

children.text: eva maitraku asaṅgagocaro dṛṣṭa sūdhana guṇaiḥ samudgatam /
children.translated_text: Thus <s>Maitreya</s>, of unobstructed range, having beheld <s>Sudhana</s> risen in virtues,

children.text: darśayitva pariṣāya saṃmukhaṃ varṇakośamimu tasya vyāhari // 171 //
children.translated_text: Displaying him before the assembly, spoke this treasury of praise regarding him. // 171 //

children.text: śrutva sūdhana tadānuśāsanīmīdṛśīṃ ca anuśāsti uttamām /
children.translated_text: Having heard that instruction and such supreme teaching,
<s>Sudhana</s>, his senses overflowing with a surge of joy, released copious streams of tears. // 172 //
With all his hair standing on end in delight, sighing with gladdened senses,

children.text: utthihitva sudhanaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ maitra nāma kurute pradakṣiṇam // 173 //
children.translated_text: <s>Sudhana</s> arose, and with palms joined, circumambulated the one named <s>Maitreya</s>. // 173 //

children.text: tasya mañjuśiri tena tejasā puṣpahāraratanā ca pāṇiṣu /
children.translated_text: Through the spiritual power of <s>Mañjuśrī</s>, flowers, garlands, and jewels appeared in his hands,
Resplendent and delightful, arisen from <s>bodhisattva</s> vows. // 174 //

children.text: sūdhano varaprahṛṣṭamānaso maitrakasya kṣipi tāni harṣitaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Sudhana</s>, with a supremely joyful mind, joyously cast those upon <s>Maitreya</s>,

children.text: tasya śīrṣu parimārjate tadā maitranātha sudhanaṃ ca bhāṣate // 175 //
children.translated_text: And then wiped his head; the lord <s>Maitreya</s> then spoke to <s>Sudhana</s>: // 175 //

children.text: sādhu sādhu jinaputra sūdhana yasya te aparikheda īdṛśaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Well done, well done, O son of the <s>Jina</s>, <s>Sudhana</s>, whose unweariness is such as this,

children.text: tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi guṇāna bhājanaṃ mañjughoṣu yatha yādṛśo va ham // 176 //
children.translated_text: You shall become a vessel of virtues, just as <s>Mañjughoṣa</s> and just as I am.' // 176 //

children.text: śrutva sūdhana udānudānayi durlabhā bhavaśateṣu īdṛśāḥ /
children.translated_text: Having heard this, <s>Sudhana</s> uttered an exclamation of inspired joy: 'Rare in hundreds of existences are such as these,

children.text: mitra yebhiriha me samāgamaḥ sādu āgamanamadya me iha // 177 //
children.translated_text: These friends with whom I have come together here -- good is my coming here today! // 177 //
Well it is that I have gone to the farther shore of the virtues of beings! Through the power of <s>Mañjughoṣa</s>,

children.text: mitra labdha maya durlabhā ime bhotu me laghu samāgamasvayi // 178 //
children.translated_text: I have found these rare friends -- may there swiftly be a meeting with you!' // 178 //

body.text: atha khalu sudhanaḥ śreṣṭhidārako maitreyasya bodhisattvasya purataḥ prāñjaliḥ sthitvā evamāha - ahamārya anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhāvabhisaṃprasthitaḥ / na ca jānāmi kathaṃ bodhisattvena bodhisattvacaryāyāṃ śikṣitavyam, kathaṃ pratipattavyam / āryamaitreyo vyākṛtaḥ sarvatathāgatairekajātipratibaddhatayā anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau / yaścaikajatipratibaddho 'nuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau, sa samatikrāntaḥ sarvabodhisattvavyavasthānāni, so 'vakrānto bodhisattvaniyāmam / tena paripūritāḥ sarvapāramitāḥ / so 'vatīrṇaḥ sarvāśākṣāntimukhāṇi / tena pratilabdhāḥ sarvabodhisattvabhūmayaḥ / sa vikrīḍitaḥ sarvavimokṣamukheṣu / tena pariniṣpāditāḥ sarvasamādhayaḥ / sa gatiṃgataḥ sarvabodhisattvagatiṣu / tena pratilabdhāḥ sarvadhāraṇīpratibhānā ālokanayāḥ / sa vaśiprāptaḥ sarvabodhisattvavaśitāsu / tena samupārjitāḥ sarvabodhisattvasaṃbhārāḥ / sa vikrīḍitaḥ prajñopāyakauśalyanayeṣu / tenotpāditā mahābhijñāvidyājñānālokanayāḥ / sa niryātaḥ sarvaśikṣāsu / tena pariśodhitāḥ sarvabodhisattvacaryāḥ / tenābhinirhṛtāni sarvapraṇidhānaniryāṇamukhāni / tena pratīṣṭāni sarvatathāgatavyākaraṇāni / so 'bhijñaḥ sarvayānaniryāṇamukhānām / tena saṃdhāritāni sarvatathādhiṣṭhānāni / tena saṃgṛhītā sarvabuddhabodhiḥ / tenādhāritāḥ sarvatathāgatakośāḥ / sa gañjadharaḥ sarvatathāgataguhyānām / sa mūrdhaprāptaḥ sarvabodhisattvaguhyamaṇḍalasya / sa śūraḥ sarvakleśavaṃśavikṣobhitāsu / sa daiśikaḥ saṃsārāṭavīprāptānām / sa vaidyaḥ kleśāturāṇām / so 'graḥ sarvasattvānām / sa indraḥ, sa jyeṣṭhaḥ sarvāryapudgalānām / sa uttamaḥ sarvāryaśrāvakapratyekabuddhānām /
body.translated_text: Then indeed <s>Sudhana</s> the merchant's son, standing before the <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>Maitreya</s> with palms joined, spoke thus: 'I, O Noble One, have set forth toward unsurpassed perfect awakening. Yet I do not know how a <s>bodhisattva</s> should practice the <s>bodhisattva</s> career...

body.text:
sa karṇadhāraḥ saṃsārasāgaraprāptānām / tenākarṣitaṃ mahattvasattvavinayopāyajālam / tena vyavalokitāni paripakvajagadindriyāṇi / sa saṃprayuktaḥ sarvasattvānām, paripālanayuktaḥ sarvabodhisattvānām / sa saṃgāyanaprayuktaḥ sarvabodhisattvakriyāsu / sa saṃsthitaḥ sarvatathāgataparṣanmaṇḍaleṣu / sa pratibhāsaprāptaḥ sarvajagadbhavaneṣu / so 'nupaliptaḥ sarvalokadharmaiḥ / sa samatikrāntaḥ sarvamāraviṣayebhyaḥ / so 'nugataḥ sarvabuddhaviṣayam / so 'nāvaraṇaprāptaḥ sarvabodhisattvaviṣaye / sa pūjāprayuktaḥ sarvatathāgatānām / sa ekotībhāvagataḥ sarvabuddhadharmeṣu / tasyāvabaddho 'bhiṣekapaṭṭaḥ / tenādhyāsitaṃ mahādharmarājyam / so 'bhiṣiktaḥ sarvajñajñānaviṣaye / tataḥ prabhavaḥ sarvabuddhadharmāṇām / tasya bodhiprāptaṃ sarvajñajñānādhipatyam / tadvadatu me āryaḥ - kathaṃ bodhisattvena bodhisattvacaryāyāṃ
śikṣitavyam, kathaṃ pratipattavyam, yathā pratipadyamāno bodhisattvo bodhimadhigacchati, sarvabuddhadharmān pratimānayati, yathānimantritaṃ sattvadhātumuttārayati, yathābhirūḍhāṃ pratijñāṃ nistārayati, mahābodhicaryārambhaṃ samāśvāsayati sadevakaṃ lokaṃ na visaṃvadati, ātmanā sarvabuddhadharmasaṃghān vyavacchinatti / buddhāvaṃśamaśūnyīkaroti bodhisattvakulam / saṃdhārayati tathāgatanetrīm //
body.translated_text: He is the helmsman of those who have reached the ocean of <s>saṃsāra</s>. By him the great net of skillful means for disciplining beings has been drawn forth. By him the faculties of beings ripe for maturation have been surveyed. He is connected with all beings, devoted to the protection of all <s>bodhisattvas</s>.

body.text: atha khalu maitreyo bodhisattvaḥ sarvaṃ tatparṣanmaṇḍalamavalokya sudhanaṃ śreṣṭhidārakamupadarśayannevamāha - paśyatha kulaputrā imaṃ śreṣṭhiputram, yo 'yaṃ māṃ bodhisattvacaryāguṇapariniṣpattiṃ paripṛcchati / eṣa mārṣāḥ śreṣṭhidārakaḥ anena vīryārambheṇa, anayā arthikatayā, etena cchandasamādānena, etayā dṛḍhāśayatayā, anivartyavīryatayā, etayā buddhadharmātṛptatayā, etayā viśeṣaparimārgaṇatayā, etayā dīptaśiraścailopamatayā, etayā kalyāṇamitradarśanakāmatayā, etayā kalyāṇamitraparyupāsanāparikhedatayā sarvakalyāṇamitrāṇi parimārgamāṇaḥ paripṛcchan paryupāsīno mañjuśriyā kumārabhūtena saṃpreṣito dhanyākarānnagarādupādāya sarvadakṣiṇāpathamaṭan daśottaraṃ kalyāṇamitraśataṃ paripṛcchan yāvanmamāntikamanuprāptaḥ sarvaparikhedavigatenādhyāśayena / durlabhaṃ kulaputrā evaṃrūpāṇāṃ mahāyānasaṃprasthitānāṃ mahāpratijñāsamārūḍhānāṃ mahārambhavyavasitamānasānāṃ mahākaruṇāsaṃnaddhagātrāṇāṃ mahāmaitrīsattvaparitrāṇamatīnāṃ mahāvīryapāramitodyuktānāṃ mahāsattvasārthaparipālanābhiyuktānāṃ mahāsaṃsārasāgarasattvatāraṇapratipannānāṃ sarvajñatāmārgasaṃprasthitānāṃ mahādharmanausamudānayanodyuktānāṃ mahādharmaratnapuṇyasamudānayanakṛtavyavasāyānāṃ mahādharmayajñasaṃbhāropacayodyuktānāṃ nāmadheyaśravaṇaṃ vā rūpakāyadarśanaṃ vā gocarasaṃvāso vā caryāsabhāgatā vā / tatkasya hetoḥ? eṣa hi kulaputrāḥ satpuruṣaḥ sarvajagatparitrāṇāya abhyutthitaḥ, sarvaduḥkhasattvaparimocanatāyai sarvadurgatisamucchoṣaṇāya sarvākṣaṇavinivartanāya sarvaviṣamamārgaparivartanatāyai sarvājñānatamondhakāravidhamanatāyai sarvasaṃsārakāntārasamatikramaṇatāyai sarvagaticakravinivartanatāyai sarvamāraviṣayasamatikramaṇatāyai sarvaniketasthānoccalanatāyai sarvālayanilayonnodanatāyai kāmapaṅkasamuddharaṇatāyai nandīrāgaprahāṇāya dṛṣṭibandhananirhāraṇāya satkāyābhiṣvaṅgavinivartanatāyai saṃjñāpāśasamucchedanatāyai
body.translated_text: Then indeed the <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>Maitreya</s>, surveying the entire assembly, displaying <s>Sudhana</s> the merchant's son, spoke thus: 'Behold, O sons of good family, this merchant's son, who approaches me to inquire about the accomplishment of the qualities of the <s>bodhisattva</s> career...

body.text: viparyāsapathavinivartanatāyai anuśalyasamābṛṃhaṇatāyai nivaraṇakavāṭanirbhedanatāyai āvaraṇaparvatavikiraṇatāyai tṛṣṇājāloddharaṇatāyai avidyāsaṃyojanaviśleṣakaraṇatāyai bhavoddyotakaraṇatāyai māyāśāṭhyaprahāṇāya cittakāluṣyaprasādanāya saṃśayavimativilekhanasamuddharaṇatāyai ajñānamahaughottaraṇatāyai sarvasaṃsāradoṣavijugupsanatāyai pratipannaḥ //
body.translated_text: for the turning back from the path of perversion, for the nurturing of the dart-removal, for the breaking open of the gate-bar of the hindrances, for the scattering of the mountains of obstructions, for the pulling up of the net of craving, for the severing of the fetters of ignorance, for the illumination of existence, for the [dispelling of] illusion...

body.text: eṣa hi kulaputrāḥ satpuruṣaḥ sattvānāṃ caturoghottaraṇatāyai mahādānaṃ mahādharmanāvaṃ samudānetukāmo dṛṣṭipaṅkanimagnānāṃ mahādharmasetuṃ sthāpayitukāmo mohāndhakāraprāptānāṃ jñānālokaṃ kartukāmaḥ saṃsārakāntārapranaṣṭānāmāryamārgaṃ saṃdarśayitukāmaḥ mahākleśavyādhiprapīḍitānāṃ dharmabhaiṣajyaṃ pradātukāmo jātijarāmaraṇopadrutānāmamṛtadhātuṃ dātukāmaḥ trividhāgnisaṃpradīptānāṃ śamathasalilena prahlādayitukāmaḥ śokaparidevaduḥkhadaurmanasyopāyāsasaṃtaptānāṃ mahāśvāsaṃ dātukāmo bhavacārakāvaruddhānāṃ jñānaprahāṇaṃ dātukāmo dṛṣṭibandhanabaddhānāṃ prajñāśastramupasaṃhartukāmaḥ traidhātukanagarāvaruddhānāṃ mokṣadvāraṃ darśayitukāmaḥ traidhātukanagarāvaruddhānāṃ muktidvāraṃ darśayitukāmaḥ akṣemadigabhimukhānāṃ kṣemāṃ diśamupadarśayitukāmaḥ kleśasaṃskāropadrutānāṃ mahāśvāsaṃ dātukāmo durgatiprapātabhayabhītānāṃ hastālambaṃ dātukāmaḥ skandhavadhakapraghātitānāṃ nirvāṇanagaramupadarśayitukāmo dhātūragaparivṛtānāṃ niḥsaraṇamākhyātukāmaḥ āyatanaśūnyagrāmasaṃniśritānāṃ prajñālokena niṣkāśayitukāmaḥ kutīrthapratipannān samyaktīrthamavatārayitukāmaḥ amitrahastagatānāṃ bhūtakalyāṇamitrāṇi darśayitukāmo bāladharmagocarābhiratānāmāryadharmeṣu pratiṣṭhāpayitukāmaḥ saṃsārapurābhiratānuccālya sarvajñatāpuraṃ praveśayitukāmaḥ //
body.translated_text: For this good man, sons of good family, desires to bring forth the great gift, the great ship of <s>Dharma</s>, for beings to cross over the four floods (<s>ogha</s>); desires to establish the great bridge of <s>Dharma</s> for those sunk in the mud of wrong views; desires to create the light of knowledge for those engulfed in the darkness of delusion; desires to show the Noble Path to those lost in the wilderness of <s>saṃsāra</s>; desires to give the medicine of <s>Dharma</s> to those afflicted by the great disease of the <s>kleśas</s> (defilements); desires to give the nectar-element (<s>amṛtadhātu</s>) to those oppressed by birth, old age, and death; desires to refresh with the water of <s>śamatha</s> (tranquility) those ablaze with the threefold fire; desires to give great solace to those scorched by grief, lamentation, suffering, dejection, and despair; desires to give the weapon of knowledge to those imprisoned in the prison of becoming; desires to bring the sword of wisdom (<s>prajñā</s>) to those bound by the bonds of wrong views; desires to show the gate of liberation to those imprisoned in the city of the three realms; desires to show the door of freedom to those imprisoned in the city of the three realms; desires to point out the direction of safety to those facing the direction of danger; desires to give great solace to those afflicted by the <s>saṃskāras</s> (formations) of the <s>kleśas</s>; desires to give a hand to hold to those terrified by the fear of falling into evil destinies; desires to show the city of <s>Nirvāṇa</s> to those struck down by the killer of the <s>skandhas</s> (aggregates); desires to proclaim the way of escape to those surrounded by the poison of the <s>dhātus</s> (elements); desires to lead out with the light of wisdom those who have settled in the empty village of the <s>āyatanas</s> (sense-bases); desires to lead those who have entered false fords to the right ford; desires to show true spiritual friends to those fallen into the hands of enemies; desires to establish in the Noble <s>Dharma</s> those who delight in the domain of childish teachings; desires to dislodge those who delight in the city of <s>saṃsāra</s> and lead them into the city of omniscience. //

body.text: sa eṣa kulaputrāḥ satpuruṣaḥ evaṃ sattvaparitrāṇāya apratiprasrabdho bodhicittotpādaviśuddhiṃ parimārgamāṇo 'yamaparikhinno mahāyānasamudānayāya, aparitṛptaḥ, sarvadharmameghayānaiḥ, nityodyuktaḥ sarvasaṃbhāraparipūraṇāya, anikṣiptadhuraḥ sarvadharmamukhaparyavadāpanāya, asaṃśritavīryaḥ sarvabodhisattvacaraṇatāyai, anivartaprayogaḥ sarvapraṇidhānābhinirhārāya, avitṛptaḥ sarvakalyāṇamitradarśanena, aklāntakāyaḥ sarvakalyāṇamitraparyupāsanena, pradakṣiṇagrāhī sarvakalyāṇamitrāvavādānuśāsanīṣu //
body.translated_text: This good man, sons of good family, thus unrelenting in the rescue of beings, seeking the purification of the generation of <s>bodhicitta</s> (the mind of awakening) — he is unwearied in bringing forth the <s>Mahāyāna</s> (Great Vehicle), unsatiated with all the <s>Dharma</s>-cloud vehicles, ever diligent in fulfilling all the accumulations, unbowed in his burden of mastering all <s>Dharma</s>-gateways, of unfailing energy in all <s>Bodhisattva</s>-practices, of irreversible application in accomplishing all vows, unsatiated by seeing all spiritual friends, of untired body in attending upon all spiritual friends, and receptive to the instructions and exhortations of all spiritual friends. //

body.text: durlabhāḥ kulaputrāste sattvāḥ sarvaloke, ye 'nuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau praṇidadhati / ataste durlabhatarāḥ sattvāḥ, ye 'nuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃprasthitāḥ / īdṛśena vīryārambhaprayogena buddhadharmān samudānayanti / īdṛśyā tīvracchandikatayā bodhisattvamārgaṃ paryeṣante / īdṛśyā arthikatayā bodhisattvacaryāṃ pariśodhayanti / īdṛśena śrameṇa kalyānamitrāṇi paryupāsate / īdṛśyā dīptaśiraścailopamatayā kalyāṇamitrajñānaṃ na vilomayanti / īdṛśyā dṛḍhādhyāśayapratipattyā kalyāṇamitrānuśāsanīṣu pratipadyante / īdṛśyā pradakṣiṇagrāhitayā sarvabodhyaṅgāni samārjayanti / īdṛśyā sarvalābhasatkāraślokānarthikatayā bodhisattvādhyāśayadhātumavikopakriyayā
body.translated_text: Rare in all the world, sons of good family, are those beings who aspire to unsurpassed perfect awakening. Even rarer than those are the beings who, having set out toward unsurpassed perfect awakening, bring forth the <s>Buddha</s>-qualities with such an undertaking of energetic effort, who seek the <s>Bodhisattva</s> path with such intense zeal, who purify the <s>Bodhisattva</s>-conduct with such earnest desire, who attend upon spiritual friends with such exertion, who do not go against the knowledge of spiritual friends with such urgency as if their head were on fire, who practice the instructions of spiritual friends with such firm resolve and devotion, who polish all the limbs of awakening (<s>bodhyaṅga</s>) with such receptivity, who with such indifference to all gains, honors, and fame, without corrupting the element of <s>Bodhisattva</s> noble aspiration,

body.text: īdṛśyā gṛhabhogakāmaratisukhamātāpitṛjñātisarvavastvanapekṣaparityāgatayā bodhisattvamahāyānān paryeṣante / īdṛśyā kāyajīvitanirapekṣatayā sarvajñatāmabhilaṣante / na hi kulaputrastāmanye bodhisattvāḥ kalpakoṭīniyutaśatasahasrairbodhisattvacaryāpraṇidhiparipūrimadhigamiṣyante buddhabodhau vasanto bhaviṣyanti buddhakṣetrapariśuddhau vā, sattvaparipākavinaye vā, dharmadhātujñānapraveśe vā, pāramitāsamudāgame vā, caryājālapravistāre vā, praṇidhānābhinirhāraparipūryāṃ vā, mārakarmasamatikramaṇe vā, kalyāṇamitrārāgaṇe vā, sarvabodhisattvacaryāsamudānayapariśodhane vā, samantabhadrabodhisattvacaryābhinirhārabalapariniṣpattau vā samudāgamiṣyanti, yadeṣo 'nena ekajanmapratilambhena adhigamiṣyati //
body.translated_text: who seek the great vehicle of the <s>Bodhisattva</s> with such abandonment, heedless of home, possessions, sensual pleasures, happiness, mother, father, relatives, and all belongings; who aspire to omniscience with such disregard for body and life. For indeed, sons of good family, other <s>Bodhisattvas</s> will not, even in hundreds of thousands of <s>koṭī-niyutas</s> of <s>kalpas</s> of <s>Bodhisattva</s>-practice and vow-fulfillment, attain what this one will attain in a single lifetime — whether abiding in <s>Buddha</s>-awakening, or purification of <s>Buddha</s>-fields, or ripening and disciplining of beings, or entry into the knowledge of the <s>dharmadhātu</s>, or accomplishment of the <s>pāramitās</s> (perfections), or expansion of the net of conduct, or fulfillment of the accomplishment of vows, or transcending the works of <s>Māra</s>, or devotion to spiritual friends, or accomplishing and purifying all <s>Bodhisattva</s>-conduct, or perfecting the power of accomplishing the conduct of <s>Samantabhadra</s> <s>Bodhisattva</s>. //

body.text:

body.translated_text: Then indeed <s>Maitreya</s> <s>Bodhisattva</s> <s>Mahāsattva</s>, having proclaimed the true qualities of <s>Sudhana</s> the merchant's son, and having thereby strengthened the awakening-aspiration of hundreds of thousands of living beings, spoke thus to <s>Sudhana</s> the merchant's son: 'Excellent! Excellent, son of good family! You have generated the aspiration for unsurpassed perfect awakening for the welfare and happiness of all the world, for the rescue of all the realms of beings, for the attainment of all <s>Buddha</s>-qualities. Well-gained are your gains, son of good family, and welcome are you as one who has obtained human birth. Well-lived is your life among the living. You have won the favor of the arising of <s>Buddhas</s>. Well-seen by you is <s>Mañjuśrī</s> as a spiritual friend. Your continuum is well-moistened. You are well-irrigated by wholesome roots. You are well-supported by bright <s>dharmas</s>. Well-purified is your noble aspiration and virtuous intention. You have been taken up by all <s>Buddhas</s>. You are well-embraced by spiritual friends, son of good family, with the aspiration by which you have generated the mind of unsurpassed perfect awakening. And for what reason? <s>Bodhicitta</s> (the mind of awakening), son of good family, is like a seed, for it is the seed of all <s>Buddha</s>-qualities; like a field, for it makes the bright <s>dharmas</s> of all the world grow; like the ground, for it is the refuge of all the world; like water, for it washes away all the stains of the <s>kleśas</s>; like wind, for it has no abode in all the world; like fire, for it burns the fuel-thicket of all wrong views and clinging; like the sun, for it illuminates the abodes of all beings; like the moon, for it fills the circle of bright <s>dharmas</s>; like a lamp, for it creates the light of <s>Dharma</s>; like an eye, for it shows the even and the uneven; like a path, for it leads into the city of omniscience; like a ford, for it avoids false fords; like a vehicle, for all <s>Bodhisattvas</s> mount it; like a door, for it enters the gateway of all <s>Bodhisattva</s>-conduct; like a mansion, for it provides the inclination toward the cultivation of <s>samādhis</s>; like a park, for it brings the experience of delight in the <s>Dharma</s>; like a refuge, for it rescues all the world; like a shelter, for it bears the welfare of all the world; like a support, for it supports all <s>Bodhisattva</s>-practices; like a father, for it protects all <s>Bodhisattvas</s>; like a mother, for it gives birth to all beings; like a nurse, for it guards from all sides; like a king, for it surpasses the minds of all <s>śaikṣas</s> (learners), <s>aśaikṣas</s> (adepts), and <s>Pratyekabuddhas</s>; like a sovereign, for it excels through all vows; like a great ocean, for it is the gathering-place of all jewels of qualities; like great <s>Meru</s>, for it has equanimity toward all beings; like <s>Cakravāla</s>, for it is the refuge of all the world; like the <s>Himavat</s> (Himalayas), for it makes the herbs of knowledge grow; like <s>Gandhamādana</s>, for it is the support of all fragrances of qualities; like space, for it is vast with great qualities; like a lotus, for it is unstained by the <s>dharmas</s> of all the world; like a bull-elephant, for it is tamed and noble; like a thoroughbred horse, for it is free from all vice; like a charioteer, for it goes at the forefront leading to the great vehicle; by healing the disease of <s>kleśas</s> (afflictions); it becomes an abyss, by bringing about the exhaustion of all unwholesome <s>dharmas</s>; it becomes a <s>vajra</s> (diamond), by penetrating all <s>dharmas</s>; it becomes a perfume casket, by producing the fragrance of qualities; it becomes a great flower, by being a sight delightful to the entire world; it becomes Himalayan sandalwood, by refreshing the burning of passion; it becomes a peacock's tail, by pervading the entire <s>dharmadhātu</s>; it becomes the great medicine-king <s>Sudarśana</s>, by destroying the disease of all <s>kleśas</s>; it becomes the medicine <s>Vigama</s>, by extracting the thorns of all latent tendencies;
